title: 圣化寺 Shenghua Si
subtitle: a temple · outside the walls · confidence A, assumed

model.line: Massing only, not a reconstruction: 18 plain blocks (walls, houses, halls), a tinted patch of ground. Its houses, rows and halls are generated to the kind of place, not drawn from a plan of it: assumed (C). The switch `around=0` hides everything outside the walls.

searched: No picture of it found in the catalogues searched for the surroundings.

facts.label: In English
facts.value: Temple of Holy Transformation (with a palace court 北所)

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a temple outside the garden walls

facts.label: In 1860
facts.value: in use? razed to fields after 1860/1900 (S1201 lead); gone today

facts.label: Where
facts.value: 巴沟村 (osm node 2054336393): the temple lay SSW of the village (S1201 lead), offset unknown, at the ring's south edge: C

facts.label: Note
facts.value: S05 j78: 2 li south of the 小西厂's south gate; canal on the west, rice fields on the east, a big river in front; hall five bays, 观音阁, 龙王殿; the 北所 palace court with 欣稼亭. Kangxi-era (S02 p.103). Qianlong's 1743 poem from the boat from 西苑 to it (S02 p.103).
